# UI v3 booking: draft notes (not the build log)

## Part A (server), 21/11
- One guard `assertTransition` (`src/lib/booking/transitions.ts`): On hold -> Booked | Cancelled; Booked -> Completed | Cancelled. Provider takes every edge; Tour Agency only cancels On hold. A cancellation needs a reason. Used by `change-status.ts` and `mark-arrival.ts`.
- `createBooking`: only for an Agency that has a Chat (any status) with the Provider; slot capacity checked inside the write lock (`slotOccupancy`).
- Capacity (decision 7) with the schema's EXCLUDE gist kept (human choice): one booking per provider time slot, so the check is group_size <= max_participants in the transaction.
- Hold expiry reason is now "Hết hạn giữ chỗ". `docs/spec/specs/spec-BKG.md` lines 453 and 542 (#46) still say "Automatic expiry: 72-hour On hold elapsed": the spec owner must update them.
- Scanner moved to `src/instrumentation.ts` (needs `experimental.instrumentationHook` in Next 14). Reads still expire due holds. No scanner existed in Explore.
- Migration `20261121100000_hab_booking_contact_fields.sql`: contact_name, contact_phone, note (nullable). Applied to DEV by the human on 21/11.
- Test fixture shim `tests/setup/booking-pair-chat.ts`: the seed has no chat for the demo agency/provider pair. Proper fix: a seed row (data/ owner), then delete the shim.

## Part B, third round (21/11 night)
- Edit 35: Ngày (date input) + "Giờ bắt đầu" (select of the experience time slots, like create). One server rule for create and edit (`src/lib/booking/slot-rules.ts`): when the experience has slots, the start must be a slot start on that weekday; capacity (guests in overlapping bookings of the experience + this group ≤ max_participants) is checked on create and on every edit that moves the time or changes the group. The slot rule runs on edit only when the start moves, so a booking created before slots existed can still change its group size. A current start that is not a slot stays as an extra option in the select so the form never moves it silently. Experiences without slots keep the free start (a time input). Create now also enforces the slot rule (it did not before).
- Price display (05, 06, 07, 10c, 10, 35): "Giảm giá đoàn" always comes from `experience_discount_rules` on the list price; when `agreed_price_total` differs from the rule price a line "Điều chỉnh theo thoả thuận: +X ₫ / −X ₫" is shown; the list price is struck out only when the final price is below it. Tested for equal, lower and higher (unit: `v3-booking-view`; pages: `v3-price-pages`; create form: `v3-booking-form`). The page-level tests were written after the code; a mutation check (strike always on) made them fail. 35: the typed per-guest price still gets the group discount applied (price = typed price × guests − rule %), the adjustment line shows the difference to the rule price on the list price.
- 27: "Xem thêm" centred under the month list, linking to 05 (as in the mockup). The "‹ Lịch sử đặt chỗ" link above the title stays (spec #68); it is not in the mockup. The mockup lists three months, this page lists the chosen month.
- 25: list = search box ("Tìm theo tên hoặc trải nghiệm", filters by organization, participant or experience, no case or accents), items with three lines (name, experience, time), no "Tin nhắn / N hội thoại" header (kept for screen readers). Thread header: "Trải nghiệm: …". `listChats` now returns `experience_name` (extra field of the list output; the old equality assertion in `iac-list-chats` allows it). Not in the mockup but kept for function: the "Tạo đặt chỗ / Đóng hội thoại / Đặt chỗ / Lịch" buttons in the thread header, the unread count in the list (mockup shows it as a badge, same here), the message preview (now only the fallback when a chat has no experience).
- Old tests changed in this round: `hanoi-time-display` FR-004 (date and time of day instead of one datetime-local value), `iac-list-chats` (new field).
- "Cần sửa chung": none.

## Fixes after Khánh Linh's manual test (21/11 night)
1. **Guests field.** `GuestsInput` / `GuestsField` (`src/app/explore/v3/GuestsInput.tsx`): `<input type="number" inputmode="numeric" min=1 max=…>`, message under the field ("Tối đa N khách mỗi ca", "Nhập số khách từ 1"), submit blocked on error, the server still checks. Used in: the "Giá & lịch trống" bar of 04 (page-specific form, `src/app/explore/experiences/[id]/page.tsx`), the request form (04 and 24; 24 passes the maximum from the seed), 35 create and 35 edit (the edit page now passes `maxGuests`).
   **Not changed (shared) — "Cần sửa chung":** the guests `<select>` in `src/app/explore/v3/SearchBar.tsx:13-14` (search bar of 01/21 `/explore`, 02 `/explore/search`, 04/23 top bar `/explore/experiences/[id]`) and in `src/app/village/[villageId]/page.tsx:75-76` (03). `FilterPanel.tsx` "Số khách mỗi ca" (02 filters) is a filter, not the booking flow. The select offers 1–60 and has no maximum per experience, so it needs the owner of the explore screens to decide.
2. **Chat 25 header.** `chatActions` returns nothing for the Agency and only "Tạo đặt chỗ" for the Provider. The close-chat dialog code in `src/app/messages/page.tsx` is now unreachable (no button opens it); the close API and `close-chat.ts` stay. Old test `iac-chat-view` (chatActions) changed: before, Agency Active = close/bookings/schedule and Provider Active = create_booking/close/bookings, Closed had no close; now Agency = [] and Provider = [create_booking] (decision 21/11).
3. **Request needs a free slot.** `GET /api/bkg/requests/slots?experience_id&date` and `freeSlotsOn` (same rule as the table of 04: slots of the weekday that operating hours and On hold/Booked bookings leave free). The form shows a required "Ca" select; a day without a free slot shows "Ngày này xưởng không có ca trống" and the submit stays disabled. The server refuses a request without a slot (400 VALIDATION_ERROR) or with a slot that is not free that day (409 SLOT_UNAVAILABLE). The card in 25 shows "Khung giờ HH:mm–HH:mm" and the note only when there is one. Existing tests that sent requests were given slot fixtures (`tests/helpers/slots.ts`); the demo workshop is open on Mondays only (provider_operating_hours), so fixtures use Mondays. An experience with no `experience_slots` rows cannot receive requests any more.
4. **Display.** 06/07 final price block: label "Giá" (06 and 07), right column stacked (struck list price above, big price below), money elements `white-space: nowrap` (`.v3a-tot b`, `.v3a-old`, `.v3a-money`, and on 05 `.v3g-total/-old/-disc/-tag`). 10c/10 use the same classes. 05 search box min-width 400 px (hint is about 34 characters).
